args.command:
$t = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp'
foreach ($d in 'vmm-big', 'vmm-loop') { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$t\$d") { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$t\$d" -Recurse -Force } }
[void](New-Item -ItemType Directory "$t\vmm-big", "$t\vmm-loop")
fsutil file createnew "$t\vmm-big\f" 4294967296
cmd /c mklink /J "$t\vmm-loop\back" "$t\vmm-loop"

$t = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Temp'
Start-Sleep 2
foreach ($d in 'vmm-big', 'vmm-loop') { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "$t\$d" -Recurse -Force }
'left=' + (@('vmm-big', 'vmm-loop') | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath "$t\$_" }).Count
'vmm=' + (Get-ChildItem -Force -LiteralPath $t -Filter '.vmm-*' | Measure-Object).Count
'tar=' + (Get-Process -Name tar -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count
